title: Generation of Bioengineered Neuronal Organoids (BENOs) from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Coat T25 flask with 1:120 (in DPBS) growth factor reduced Matrigel™ (100 µL/cm²).
Incubate the coated flask for 30 min in ambient air incubator with 5.0% CO₂ and 37 °C.
Plate cells with 4 mL of iPS-Brew XF media and 5 mmol/L ROCKi.
Place PSC in ambient air incubator with 5.0% CO₂ and 37 °C.
Change medium daily (4 mL) until cells reach confluence of 70-80%.
Aspirate cell culture media in T25 flask.
Wash with 3 mL 1x DPBS two times, aspirate DPBS after each washing step.
Incubate PSCs with 0.5 mmol/L EDTA for 2-3 min.
Aspirate EDTA solution and tap the flask side until cell detachment is observed.
Resuspend iPSC in 10 mL Brew supplemented with 10 µmol/L ROCKi.
Determine cell count using a Neubauer chamber with 1:5 0.4 % Trypan blue or by an automated cytometer.
Incubate 2x10^6 cells with 4 % Histofix at a 1:1 ratio for 15 min.
Centrifuge fixed cells at 300 g for 10 min.
Wash cells twice in 1x DPBS.
Store cells in DPBS at 4 °C for up to 1 week.
Centrifuge remaining cell resuspension at 100 g for 3 min.
Resuspend cell pellet in Brew supplemented with 20 ng/mL FGF2 and 10 µmol/L ROCKi to achieve a concentration of 4500 cells/µL.
Add a 1:1 ratio of Collagen and 2x DMEM to a pre-cooled vessel for BENO generation.
Neutralize the mixture with 0.1 mol/L NaOH.
Add an appropriate amount of cell resuspension to achieve a concentration of 3,000 cells/µL.
Pipette 30 µL of the BENO reconstitution mixture into a single well of a 96-well plate (U-bottom, low attachment).
Incubate for 30 min in ambient air incubator with 5.0% CO2 and 37 °C.
Add 300 µL of Brew supplemented with 10 ng/mL FGF2 and 10 µmol/L ROCKi.
Incubate overnight in ambient air incubator with 5.0% CO2 and 37 °C.

Prepare sufficient amounts of neuronal commitment medium (NCM) by adding 10 µmol/L SB 431542, 50 ng/ml LDN, and 1 µmol/L RA to Basal Medium (Neurobasal-A containing 2 mmol/L glutamine, 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 µg/mL streptomycin, 2% B27, 1% N2 supplement, 200 µmol/L ascorbic acid).
Carefully remove 200 µL of medium per well and add 200 µL of pre-warmed NCM.
Change the medium daily.
Tap plate to ensure that BENOs sediment to the bottom of the wells.
Incubate BENOs in ambient air incubator with 5.0% CO2 and 37 °C.
Transfer BENOs into 6-well plates with 5 mL NCM per well on day 3.
Aspirate 4 mL of NCM per well carefully.
Add 4 mL of fresh, pre-warmed NCM to each well.
Prepare sufficient amounts of neural progenitor expansion medium (NPEM).
Basal Medium is complemented with 10 ng/mL FGF2 and 5 ng/mL TGFB1.
Aspirate 4 mL of NPEM per well carefully.
Add 4 mL of fresh, pre-warmed NPEM to each well.
Prepare sufficient amounts of neural progenitor differentiation medium (NDM).
Basal Medium is complemented with 5 ng/ml TGFB1 and 2.5 µM DAPT.
Aspirate 4 mL of NDM per well carefully.
Add 4 mL of fresh, pre-warmed NDM to each well.
Assess BENOs on day 28.
Aspirate 4 mL of Basal Medium per well.
Add 4 mL of fresh, pre-warmed Basal Medium to each well.
Change medium every second day.
